audit.why: Sona's kit has zero hard CC pre-6 (only Power Chord poke), confirming Swain dominates the early stages.

audit.corrected: Move phases[6].side to Sona; why already describes her late takeover correctly, no rewrite needed there.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sona's Q on-hit scaling (armour alone misreads it) and the Power Chord/Hymn wind-up tell are both flagged as applicable but unstated.
audit.why: Hymn of Valor applies on-hit effects so attack-speed items scale her poke past what armour alone answers; the Power Chord charge glow is the actual all-in cue, not her spell cast.
audit.corrected: Folded both into the two bleed-fix rewrites below (dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d) since those fields were already being touched for the lint fix.

edits.before: E the carrier, pull the fragment, Q the formation — one root taxed three bars and healed yours.
edits.after: Every E root drops a Soul Fragment — grab it, and note her Power Chord glow is the wind-up cue to back off, not her cast.

edits.after: Her Q applies on-hit, so armor alone misreads the poke — brawling pre-6 at marksman range just feeds it.
